title: Leading a Team of Champions
overview: This course is designed to equip leaders with the mindset and practical tools needed to unlock the full potential of their team members. Participants will gain a comprehensive set of skills that can be immediately applied to maximize team performance, transforming each team member into a vital contributor to the overall strength of the team.
audience: This course is ideal for middle and senior managers or directors who aim to foster a championship culture within their teams and organizations by tapping into employees' hidden potential and driving a winning mentality.
methodology: The course is structured around four key learning methods: concept learning through presentations, role-playing exercises, experience sharing via round-table discussions, and analysis of case studies and scenarios.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Identify the key elements of a high-performing team
Establish and maintain a championship culture within their teams
Develop and implement growth plans that cultivate champions
Create a feedback-rich environment that sustains high performance
Transform individual champions into a cohesive, championship-winning team
